test_SentencePieceModel_init: test SentencePieceModel initialization with control symbols and verify pad_idx and unk_idx values
test_SentencePieceEncoder_encode_decode: test SentencePieceEncoder and SentencePieceDecoder to encode text to token indices and decode back
test_SentencePieceEncoder_reverse_mode: test SentencePieceEncoder with reverse=True to produce reversed token indices and decode correctly
test_SentencePieceEncoder_prefix_suffix_: test SentencePieceEncoder with prefix_tokens and suffix_tokens to prepend and append special tokens
test_SentencePieceDecoder_decode_from_to: test SentencePieceDecoder decode_from_tokens to reconstruct text from a list of token strings
